payload.core_mechanism_summary: DP over rows and columns: dp[r][c] stores ways to fill first r rows with exactly c columns containing a 1, using combinatorics and modular powers.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a 2D DP array indexed by number of rows processed and number of columns that already have a 1. Transitions use combinations, powers of k and k-1, clearly fitting dp_2d_state.
